title: Phase 1: Offer Intake
goal: Turn a signed offer into a trusted onboarding record, and load the role profile and SLA references the plan will expand.
unlocks: A validated onboarding record and the governed references the provisioning plan is built from.

title: Phase 2: Provisioning Plan
goal: Expand the role profile into a concrete task list with per-task SLAs relative to the start date.
unlocks: A dated task plan the four provisioning branches run against in parallel.

title: Phase 3: Parallel Provisioning
goal: Run the four provisioning branches in parallel - accounts, hardware, access, payroll - and record each task's state on one tracker.
unlocks: One status record over four parallel branches that the readiness gate reads.

title: Phase 4: Gate and Exceptions
goal: Fan in on task status: if every task is done inside its SLA the package is assembled; any blocked or late task is escalated.
unlocks: A readiness decision that routes a clean hire to the package and a blocked hire to escalation.

title: Phase 5: Day-One Package
goal: Assemble the Day-One Ready certificate, hand it to the hiring manager, archive the run, and feed what it taught back to the catalog.
unlocks: The delivered, acknowledged, archived onboarding that improves the next hire's role profile.
